'''lo turtau''' are lo [[tanru]] or parts of lo tanru that have a fixed meaning, which depends on their structure.

===turtau classes===
Warning: colloquially lo tanru with turtau components may have meaning different from described here.
====seltau that are adjectives/adverbials====
# '''barda''' seltau. '''lo barda broda''' = '''lo broda poi barda''', ''lo broda that is big''.
# '''cmalu''' seltau. '''lo cmalu broda''' = '''lo broda poi cmalu''', ''lo broda that is small''.
# '''zabna''' seltau.
# '''mabla''' seltau.
# '''blanu''' seltau
====x1 - bridi====
# '''cafne''' seltau. '''x1 cafne cadzu''' = '''x1 cadzu i ju'a nai lo nu go'i cu cadzu''', ''x1 often walks''
====x1 - sumti, x2  - bridi property====
# '''mutce''' seltau. '''x1 mutce broda''' unwraps into '''x1 mutce lo ka ce'u broda'''
====others====
# dispreferred: '''simxu''' seltau. '''x1 simxu broda x2''' expands into '''x1 ce x2 simxu lo ka ce'u broda ce'u''', ''x1 and x2 reciprocally broda''
